# Opt-in Tools — `setup --opt-in-tools` Generates an All-Disabled `.datamitsuignore`

## Overview

In a fresh project with many configured tools, the default experience is
"everything runs at once" — noisy and hard to adopt incrementally. This adds an
**opt-in onboarding model**: a new `--opt-in-tools` flag on `datamitsu setup`
that, in addition to the normal setup flow, generates a `.datamitsuignore` at the
git root which disables **every configured tool** via a single catch-all rule:

```bash
# Generated by `datamitsu setup --opt-in-tools`.
# All configured tools are disabled by default (opt-in model).
# Enable a tool by removing it from the list below (or add "!**/*: <tool>").
**/*: eslint, golangci-lint, hadolint, prettier, shellcheck
```

The user then **enables tools one at a time** by deleting their names from the
list (or adding `!**/*: <tool>` lines).

**Problem it solves & benefits:**

- Smooth incremental adoption: start with all tools off, turn them on deliberately.
- Uses the **existing** `.datamitsuignore` matcher — no matcher changes needed.
  Enumerating tool names (rather than `**/*: *`) is required because re-enabling
  a single tool over a `*`-disable does **not** work
  (`IsDisabled` returns `disabled[tool] || disabled["*"]`, and `!**/*: tool` only
  deletes the specific key, leaving `disabled["*"]` set — see
  `internal/datamitsuignore/matcher.go:109`).

**How it integrates:**

- Variant **(a)**: the flag runs the **full** normal `setup` (tools' config files
  are still created — without them nothing works) **and** writes the ignore file.
- Default behavior (no flag) is **unchanged**.
- The ignore file is written **before** setup's post-fix step, so that fix already
  respects the opt-in state (it becomes a no-op when all tools are disabled).

## Context (from discovery)

**Files/components involved:**

- `cmd/setup.go` — `runSetup` (full flow), flag vars (`setupDryRun`,
  `setupSkipFix`) and `init()` registration. `rootPath` resolved via
  `traverser.GetGitRoot` (L50-53); config loaded via `loadConfig()` (L56);
  post-setup fix at L187-198.
- `cmd/setup_test.go` — existing unit-test conventions (pure-function /
  constructor tests; `runSetup` is **not** exercised E2E because it needs a git
  repo + network).
- `internal/config/config.go:179` — `Tools MapOfTools` on `Config`;
  `internal/config/config.go:69` — `type MapOfTools map[string]Tool` (keys are
  tool names — the source of the disabled list).
- `internal/datamitsuignore/{parse.go,matcher.go}` — canonical rule format
  `{glob}: {tool1}, {tool2}`; generated content must parse via
  `datamitsuignore.Parse`.

**Related patterns found:**

- `**/*` is the proven catch-all glob (matches root-level AND nested files —
  `matcher_test.go:246`). Use `**/*`, not `**/**`.
- Canonical formatting (`{glob}: a, b, c`, single space after `:` and `,`) keeps
  the file stable under `datamitsu lint`/`fix`
  (`internal/bundled/datamitsuignore.go::normalizeRule`).
- setup prints results with emoji prefixes (`✨ Created:`, `🔍 DRY-RUN`).

**Docs to update:**

## Technical Details

- **Generated format** (canonical, lint-stable):
  ```
  # Generated by `datamitsu setup --opt-in-tools`.
  # All configured tools are disabled by default (opt-in model).
  # Enable a tool by removing it from the list below (or add "!**/*: <tool>").
  **/*: <sorted, comma+space-joined tool names>
  ```
- **Disabled set**: all keys of `cfg.Tools` (`config.MapOfTools`), sorted.
- **Glob**: `**/*` (catch-all; disables both per-file and per-project tools since
  it matches the synthetic project path used by `IsProjectDisabled`).
- **Write location**: `filepath.Join(rootPath, ".datamitsuignore")` at git root.
- **Ordering in `runSetup`**: resolve `rootPath` → (guard) → installs → write
  ignore → post-setup fix (now a no-op) → done.
- **Flag semantics**: variant (a) — full setup + file generation. Without the
  flag, nothing changes.
- **Safety**: refuse to overwrite an existing `.datamitsuignore` (explicit error,
  not a silent prompt) so manual tool selections are never lost.

## Post-Completion

_Items requiring manual intervention — no checkboxes, informational only._

**Manual verification:**

- In a throwaway git repo with a datamitsu config exposing ≥2 tools:
  - `datamitsu setup --opt-in-tools` → creates `.datamitsuignore` listing all
    tools; subsequent `datamitsu lint`/`check` runs nothing.
  - Remove one tool from the list → only that tool runs.
  - Re-running `datamitsu setup --opt-in-tools` with the file present → errors
    cleanly without clobbering.
  - `datamitsu setup --opt-in-tools --dry-run` → reports intent, writes nothing.
